title: Comparison with the adjacent-only construction
html: Comparison with adjacent-only construction. The transfer matrix chain computes vertex volumes at each generator by chaining the crossing coefficients. This captures the same pairwise crossing data as the Garside staircase, but factored through scalar vertex volumes rather than the full H_A(q) element. The typed Garside element retains the complete algebraic structure.
